findings.issue: feature-catalog.md:228 says this page holds the 'full implementation and validation file listings'. The tables leave files out. The Implementation table has no row for runtime/scripts/fanout-run.cjs, yet the page's own Fan-Out section says that script exports DEEP_LOOP_COVERAGE_DB_DIR (fanout-run.cjs:4114) and deals the seed round-robin (fanout-run.cjs:314-321). The Validation table lists only DRV-076, DRV-080, DRV-081 and DRV-082. It leaves out DRV-077 (seed), DRV-078 (admission prunes), DRV-079 (focus and per-node dimension coverage) and DRV-083 (frontier_drained), and DRV-083's playbook names this page as its catalog source.

The doc says 'a custom name that appears in the finding's focus is kept as its own dimension'. deriveDimension (runtime/scripts/reduce-state.cjs:1237-1244) does a substring match of each universe entry against the iteration focus plus the finding's title and description. It checks the universe in order, and the canonical four come first (buildDimensionUniverse, reduce-state.cjs:1224-1235). So when that text also contains a canonical name such as 'security', the finding goes to the canonical dimension and not to the custom name.

The doc says the active node's next uncovered dimension is dispatched 'apart from the last iteration under the cap while a core traceability protocol is unfinished'. The override in deep-review.yaml:1160 also needs max_iterations >= 2. With a cap of 1, the run keeps the frontier node's dimension even on its last iteration.

Section 13, AUTOMATED TEST CROSS-REFERENCE, lists where automated deep-review coverage lives. It names none of the suites that cover expansive depth and the stop changes, although the DRV-076 to DRV-083 scenarios in this playbook run them: runtime/tests/unit/frontier-admit-review.vitest.ts, review-depth-mode-golden.vitest.ts, stop-decision.vitest.ts and stop-decision-yaml-contract.vitest.ts. All four files exist.
